title: For not resolving my problem
text:
I am extremely disappointed with my experience today. I have been a regular Blinkit customer for a long time and have always trusted the platform for quick and reliable deliveries. However, this order completely broke that trust.

I placed an order worth over ₹5,000, and to my surprise, three products were missing from the delivery. It is unacceptable that such a high-value order was dispatched without proper verification. As a customer, I paid for every single item, so I expected every item to be delivered correctly.

What made the experience even worse was Blinkit’s customer support. Instead of helping me resolve the issue, they were completely unhelpful. Despite clearly explaining that three products were missing, I did not receive the support or resolution I expected. As a loyal customer, I expected my concern to be taken seriously, but I was left feeling ignored and frustrated.

I use Blinkit almost every day and have always preferred it over other grocery delivery apps because of its convenience and reliability. Unfortunately, this incident has completely shaken my trust in the platform. Missing multiple products in a single order reflects a serious failure in quality control, and poor customer support only makes the situation worse.

Customers should not have to waste their time proving that products were missing, repeatedly contacting support, or struggling to get a fair resolution for mistakes that were not theirs. This entire experience has been stressful, frustrating, and highly disappointing.

I sincerely hope Blinkit improves both its order verification process and its customer support. Until then, I cannot confidently recommend Blinkit, especially for expensive or high-value orders. If a company cannot ensure that customers receive everything they paid for—or provide proper support when something goes wrong—it seriously damages customer trust.

This has been one of the worst customer service experiences I’ve had. Very disappointing.

title: Complaint
text:
Dear Blinkit Customer Support,

I am writing to express my disappointment with my very first experience using Blinkit.

On **1 July**, I placed my first grocery order worth approximately **₹2,000** for my family. Unfortunately, the delivery experience was extremely disappointing.

The delivery partner failed to deliver the order on time. When I answered his call, he asked me to cancel the order myself. His communication was very poor, and he spoke only in Hindi, making it difficult for me to understand the situation.

I did **not** cancel the order. Instead, I immediately contacted your support team and requested that the order be re-delivered. However, within about **10 minutes**, the order status changed to **"Arrived"** and **"Delivered"**, even though I had not received it.

I spent more than **3 hours** contacting your support team, requesting a resolution and re-delivery. Eventually, I received only about **60% of the ordered items**, as several products were marked out of stock.

Your support team informed me that the remaining amount would be refunded within **3–5 working days**. However, I have still not received the refund. I have also been unable to contact your support team for an update.

As a first-time customer, I feel extremely disappointed and let down by this experience. The delivery process, customer support, and refund handling have all been unacceptable. I expected much better service from a company like Blinkit.

I kindly request that you:

* Process my pending refund immediately.
* Investigate why my order was marked as delivered when it had not been delivered.
* Improve your customer support and communication so that customers are not left without assistance.

I hope you will resolve this issue as soon as possible.

I ordered ice cream, and although it arrived frozen, it was obvious that it had melted previously and had been re-frozen before delivery. The texture and condition clearly indicated this. I immediately provided Blinkit with photos and videos as evidence.

This is not just a quality issue—it raises serious food safety concerns. Ice cream is a dairy product, and if it melts and is then re-frozen, it can become unsafe to consume and may no longer meet acceptable food safety standards. Selling products in this condition is unacceptable and could put customers’ health at risk.

Instead of issuing a proper refund, Blinkit told me they had provided a ₹200 refund as a coupon code. However, when I placed my next order, there was no option anywhere in the app to enter or redeem the coupon code. A refund that cannot actually be used is not a refund.

To make matters worse, I spent a long time dealing with Blinkit’s chatbot, with no meaningful resolution and no easy way to contact a real customer support representative.

Between the questionable condition of the food, the unusable refund coupon, and the lack of accessible customer support, this has been one of the worst customer service experiences I’ve had. Blinkit needs to take food quality and customer safety far more seriously. I cannot recommend this service.

title: Important: Verify the Weight of Meat Ordered Online
text:
Just a heads-up for everyone ordering chicken from Blinkit.

Today I ordered a 450 g pack of Godrej boneless chicken. I usually don’t check the weight, but this time I was making a recipe that required exactly 450 g, so I placed it on my kitchen weighing scale.

To my surprise, the pack weighed only 380 g, not 450 g.

I contacted Blinkit, and they promptly refunded me for the shortfall, which I appreciate. However, that’s not really the point. Most customers don’t weigh their groceries every time they receive an order, so discrepancies like this can easily go unnoticed.

My suggestion to everyone is to check the weight of chicken, fish, or any other items sold by weight whenever possible. Hopefully, this was just an isolated packing error, but it’s worth being aware of.

title: I’m Russian. I came to India. And I need to say something about Blinkit.
text:
In Russia we have Yandex Lavka, Samokat, all these delivery apps. And compared to India — they’ve completely lost their minds. Free delivery only in the morning, only with some weird conditions, surge pricing every five minutes, “high demand”, “weather conditions”, “courier unavailable”, blah blah blah.

Meanwhile Blinkit in India:
free delivery half the time,
cheap as hell,
and FAST.

Me and my bro ordered a ridiculous amount of food and random stuff for like 1500 rubles total. Enough for a WEEK. In Russia that money gets you depression and maybe two energy drinks.

And the speed? Indian couriers DO NOT SLEEP. I swear this country runs on shift rotations like a sci-fi factory. One guy sleeps at 6 PM and wakes up at 3 AM, another sleeps at 2 AM and wakes up at 10. Delivery never stops. Day, night, apocalypse — doesn’t matter.

And somehow there’s STILL no night surcharge.
Meanwhile Yandex be like:
“high demand 🤓”

So if you’re in India giving Blinkit less than 5 stars — you are spoiled beyond belief. Go live in Russia for a month and then come back. You’ll start kissing the courier when he arrives in 8 minutes.

Blinkit 10/10 app.

title: Blocked without Explanation
text:
I am currently visiting India from the US and had been using Blinkit with my Indian number. I successfully placed a few orders recently and was quite pleased with the app and service.

However, during my most recent attempt to place an order it was suddenly cancelled, and I started receiving a message stating “User ID/Device ID blocked.” There was no explanation or prior warning, which is both confusing and frustrating.

I understand that some transactions may have initially failed due to my US credit cards being blocked temporarily by my bank’s fraud protection system. However, every order I placed was eventually paid for successfully.

Blocking my account without any communication or opportunity to resolve the issue is incredibly disappointing—especially for a customer who was actively using and recommending your service.

While I genuinely prefer Blinkit’s interface and user experience over competitors, I was forced to switch to Zepto to complete my order. Unfortunately, given this lack of transparency and abrupt service disruption, I will continue using Zepto moving forward unless this situation is addressed appropriately.
